product_one_liner.value: Marquee unifies internal and external football data into club-specific recruitment, squad-planning and tactical intelligence for professional football clubs.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or plan page was found; the site directs prospects to a demonstration, and /pricing did not return a page.

named_customers.notes: Named club staff provide product-use testimonials on the homepage.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts describe production architecture and ML models: October 21, 2026, by CTO Jonathan Hazut, and September 25, 2026, by Chief Data Scientist Tal Darchi.

public_docs.notes: Only a single FAQ page was found, not a multi-article documentation site or help center; no public docs/help navigation link was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No current company careers page or authoritative job board was located. An older VP Data recruiting post does not establish a qualifying opening on November 9, 2026.

model_provider.notes: Marquee describes its own AI/ML models, including Squad Fit, which feeds xFit scoring. No external model provider is identified in the reviewed technical articles or security FAQ.

compliance_certs.notes: The September 13, 2026 announcement states that the SOC 2 Type II audit was completed.

last_funding.notes: July 30, 2026: the round is reported as $4 million; the company announcement gives $6.5 million as cumulative funding, not the size of this round.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 30, 2026 financing falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No current company careers page or authoritative job board was located. The available Head of Business Development advertisement is not a qualifying SDR, BDR or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 14, 2026, Marquee announced that SkillCorner users could now access Physical and Game Intelligence data through Marquee, a new data integration within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Marquee announced Yuval Foox joining as VP Data & AI on September 29, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable Head of Business Development job description names no CRM or sales/marketing system. Sports-data partners are not CRM systems.
